queries.query: Turkmenistan protest demonstration June 2026 Ashgabat rally
queries.outcome: Surfaced an RFE/RL report of June 17 protest in Mary Province over power outages.
No separate local-language event report surfaced in this query; RFE/RL English/Turkmen Service lead located via English search.

event_date.basis: RFE/RL report published June 19 explicitly says protest occurred June 17.
event_date.uncertainty: Crowd estimate is “several hundred”; reporting is attributed to eyewitnesses. RFE/RL could not reach Mary officials.

provisional_leads.location: In front of the main provincial government building, Mary city, Mary Province, Turkmenistan; participants reportedly mostly from Bayramaly district.
provisional_leads.action_summary: Residents protested frequent power cuts and demanded to see the provincial governor; police were deployed, governor met participants and promised a repair, after which they dispersed.
provisional_leads.provisional_status: promising reported lead; based on eyewitness accounts carried by RFE/RL Turkmen Service

sources.excerpt: Hundreds of people in Turkmenistan have staged a protest over power outages.
sources.provenance: Opened full article. Article dates demonstration to June 17, at provincial government building in Mary, and describes several hundred protesters and reported power outages.
sources.excerpt_note: Short source excerpt; below 25 quoted words.

failures_and_limits: RFE/RL could not reach local officials; report relies on eyewitnesses. Search queries used English and Russian, not Turkmen.
next_pass_priorities: Expand local and regional press searches, seek direct primary evidence, and resolve event dates/locations before any formal coding.
